title: CRLR/101/2010 of SANJEEV KUMAR TANDON Vs FAMILY JUDGE UDHAM SINGH NAGAR AND ANR

paras.text:
CRLR No. 101 of 2010
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
Mr. Lokendra Dobhal, Advocate for the
revisionist.
Mr. Vipul Painuly, AGA for the State.
Vide impugned judgment and order dated
14.05.2010 Judge, Family Court, Udham Singh Nagar was
pleased to sentence the husband / revisionist to undergo six
month simple imprisonment for not making payment of
maintenance as awarded under Section 125 Cr.P.C.
When present revision came for hearing before
this Court, this Court vide order dated 31.05.2010 was
pleased to issue direction that if amount of ` 48,000/- is
deposited by the revisionist before the trial court in favour
of respondent no. 2 towards maintenance, he shall be
released on bail, during the pendency of this revision, on
executing personal bond and one surety to the satisfaction
of Judge, Family Court, Udham Singh Nagar.
Learned counsel for the revisionist submits that
entire amount was deposited by the revisionist and he is
paying monthly maintenance to respondent no. 2 regularly
without there being any default.
In view of the fact that entire arrears of
maintenance have already been paid by the revisionist,
impugned judgment and order dated 14.05.2010 stands set
aside.
Revision stands disposed of accordingly.
